1→# TO 배정 대시보드 설계 문서
     2→
     3→**작성일:** 2026-03-13
     4→**프로젝트:** 교원 상시채용 원스톱 관리 시스템
     5→**기능:** 2027 TO 배정 현황 대시보드 + 관리자 편집
     6→
     7→---
     8→
     9→## 1. 개요
    10→
    11→엑셀 파일(`2027_TO_배정_최종_0310_1023.xlsx`)의 표 구조를 웹 대시보드로 구현한다.
    12→메인 페이지(`/`)가 TO 배정 현황 표를 보여주고, 관리자는 Excel 업로드 또는 인라인 편집으로 데이터를 관리한다.
    13→
    14→---
    15→
    16→## 2. 화면 구성
    17→
    18→### 2-1. 메인 페이지 (`/`) — TO 배정 대시보드
    19→
    20→- 기존 `/dean` 리다이렉트를 제거하고 TO 배정 대시보드를 렌더링
    21→- 엑셀 원본과 동일한 2단 헤더(병합 헤더 + 서브헤더) 구조
    22→- 학과당 1행, 소속대학별 행 그룹 (배경색 교대 적용)
    23→- 가로 스크롤 지원 (컬럼이 많으므로 `overflow-x-auto`)
    24→- 네비게이션 링크: 관리자 페이지(`/admin`)로 이동 버튼 포함
    25→
    26→#### 컬럼 구조 (엑셀 완전 동일)
    27→
    28→| 그룹 헤더 | 서브컬럼 | DB 컬럼명 |
    29→|-----------|---------|-----------|
    30→| 소속대학 | — | `college` |
    31→| 학과명 | — | `department` |
    32→| 교원확보율(2026.3.1기준) | 확보율(%), 교원수(명) | `confirm_rate_26`, `faculty_count_26` |
    33→| 최근 3년간 신규임용자('23~'26) | — | `new_hires` |
    34→| 최근 3년간 퇴직자('23~'25) | — | `retirees` |
    35→| 향후 정년퇴직 예정자('25~'28) | — | `upcoming_retirements` |
    36→| 요청 | 일반 / 전담 / 外 / 계 | `req_general`, `req_dedicated`, `req_external`, `req_total` |
    37→| 초빙분야 | — | `invitation_field` |
    38→| 학과요청사유 | — | `request_reason` |
    39→| 일반TO 배정(안) | 일반 / 전담 / 外 / 계 | `to_general`, `to_dedicated`, `to_external`, `to_total` |
    40→| 첨단학과신설 특별 TO 배정(안) | 일반 / 전담 / 外 / 계 | `adv_general`, `adv_dedicated`, `adv_external`, `adv_total` |
    41→| 총장TO 배정(안) | 일반 / 전담 / 外 / 계 | `pres_general`, `pres_dedicated`, `pres_external`, `pres_total` |
    42→| 배정사유 | — | `assign_reason` |
    43→| 본부 배정의견 | — | `hq_opinion` |
    44→| BIGs(전임비율 제외) | — | `bigs` |
    45→| 25년 TO신청(명) | — | `to_req_25` |
    46→| 25년 TO배정(명) | — | `to_assign_25` |
    47→| 25년 채용결과(명) | 정시 / 상시 / 합계 | `hire_regular_25`, `hire_rolling_25`, `hire_total_25` |
    48→| 참고(2025학년도 채용경과 등) | — | `note` |
    49→| 비고(BK 및 대형과제) | — | `remark` |
    50→
    51→---
    52→
    53→### 2-2. 관리자 TO 배정 관리 탭 (`/admin`)
    54→
    55→기존 관리자 페이지에 **"TO 배정 관리"** 탭을 추가한다.
    56→
    57→#### Excel 업로드
    58→- 파일 선택(`.xlsx`) → 업로드 버튼
    59→- 서버에서 `xlsx` 라이브러리로 파싱 → `to_haejung` 테이블 전체 교체
    60→- 업로드 전 확인 다이얼로그: "기존 데이터가 모두 교체됩니다. 계속하시겠습니까?"
    61→- 성공/실패 토스트 메시지
    62→
    63→#### 인라인 셀 편집
    64→- 메인 대시보드와 동일한 표를 관리자 탭에도 표시
    65→- 셀 더블클릭 → `<input>` 또는 `<textarea>`로 전환
    66→- Enter 또는 포커스 아웃 → 해당 행 PATCH 저장
    67→- 저장 전 변경된 셀: 노란 배경 강조
    68→- 저장 완료: 초록 배경 → 0.5초 후 원복
    69→
    70→---
    71→
    72→## 3. 데이터 구조
    73→
    74→### 3-1. DB 테이블: `to_haejung`
    75→
    76→```sql
    77→CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS to_haejung (
    78→  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    79→  college TEXT,
    80→  department TEXT,
    81→  confirm_rate_26 TEXT,
    82→  faculty_count_26 TEXT,
    83→  new_hires TEXT,
    84→  retirees TEXT,
    85→  upcoming_retirements TEXT,
    86→  req_general TEXT,
    87→  req_dedicated TEXT,
    88→  req_external TEXT,
    89→  req_total TEXT,
    90→  invitation_field TEXT,
    91→  request_reason TEXT,
    92→  to_general TEXT,
    93→  to_dedicated TEXT,
    94→  to_external TEXT,
    95→  to_total TEXT,
    96→  adv_general TEXT,
    97→  adv_dedicated TEXT,
    98→  adv_external TEXT,
    99→  adv_total TEXT,
   100→  pres_general TEXT,
   101→  pres_dedicated TEXT,
   102→  pres_external TEXT,
   103→  pres_total TEXT,
   104→  assign_reason TEXT,
   105→  hq_opinion TEXT,
   106→  bigs TEXT,
   107→  to_req_25 TEXT,
   108→  to_assign_25 TEXT,
   109→  hire_regular_25 TEXT,
   110→  hire_rolling_25 TEXT,
   111→  hire_total_25 TEXT,
   112→  note TEXT,
   113→  remark TEXT,
   114→  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
   115→  updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
   116→);
   117→```
   118→
   119→> 숫자 컬럼도 TEXT로 저장: "미신청", "미배정", "α" 같은 비숫자 값이 존재하기 때문
   120→
   121→### 3-2. Excel → DB 매핑 (RAW 데이터 기준)
   122→
   123→| DB 컬럼 | RAW 데이터 컬럼 |
   124→|---------|----------------|
   125→| `college` | `소속대학` |
   126→| `department` | `구분` (학과명이 없을 때 `학과명` fallback) |
   127→| `confirm_rate_26` | `(가+나+다) 적용 시 교원확보율` |
   128→| `faculty_count_26` | `26.3월 교원합계(가+나+다)` |
   129→| `new_hires` | `신규임용자_리스트` |
   130→| `retirees` | `퇴직자_리스트` |

   134→| `req_external` | `TO요청_외` |

   137→| `request_reason` | `학과요청사유_리스트` |
   138→| `to_general` | `TO배정_일반` |
   139→| `to_dedicated` | `TO배정_전담` |
   140→| `to_external` | `TO배정_외` |

   145→| `adv_total` | `첨단TO_계` |
   146→| `pres_general` | `총장TO_일반` |
   147→| `pres_dedicated` | `총장TO_전담` |
   148→| `pres_external` | `총장TO_외` |
   149→| `pres_total` | `총장TO_계` |
   150→| `assign_reason` | `배정사유` |
   151→| `hq_opinion` | `본부배정의견` |
   152→| `bigs` | `BIGs` |
   153→| `to_req_25` | `TO신청25년` |
   154→| `to_assign_25` | `TO배정25년` |
   155→| `hire_regular_25` | `채용결과_정시` |
   156→| `hire_rolling_25` | `채용결과_상시` |
   157→| `hire_total_25` | `채용결과_합계` |
   158→| `note` | `참고` |
   159→| `remark` | `비고` |
   160→
   161→---
   162→
   163→## 4. API
   164→
   165→| 메서드 | 경로 | 설명 |
   166→|--------|------|------|
   167→| GET | `/api/to-haejung` | 전체 행 조회 (배열) |
   168→| POST | `/api/to-haejung/upload` | multipart/form-data Excel 업로드 → DB 전체 교체 |
   169→| PATCH | `/api/to-haejung/[id]` | 단일 행 필드 수정 |
   170→
   171→---
   172→
   173→## 5. 컴포넌트 구조
   174→
   175→```
   176→app/
   177→  page.tsx                        ← TO 배정 대시보드 (기존 redirect 제거)
   178→  admin/
   179→    page.tsx                      ← 기존 관리자 + "TO 배정 관리" 탭 추가
   180→  api/
   181→    to-haejung/
   182→      route.ts                    ← GET
   183→      upload/
   184→        route.ts                  ← POST (Excel 업로드)
   185→      [id]/
   186→        route.ts                  ← PATCH
   187→
   188→components/
   189→  TOHaejungTable.tsx              ← 공용 표 컴포넌트 (읽기전용 + 편집모드 prop)
   190→  TOHaejungUpload.tsx             ← Excel 업로드 UI
   191→
   192→database/
   193→  schema.sql                      ← to_haejung 테이블 추가
   194→```
   195→
   196→---
   197→
   198→## 6. 기술 스택 (기존 유지)
   199→
   200→- Next.js 13+ App Router
   201→- TypeScript
   202→- Tailwind CSS
   203→- better-sqlite3 (기존 DB)
   204→- `xlsx` 패키지 (Excel 파싱, 기존 프로젝트에 추가 필요)
   205→
   206→---
   207→
   208→## 7. 비고
   209→
   210→- `xlsx` 패키지가 없으면 `npm install xlsx` 필요
   211→- 업로드 파일은 RAW 데이터 형식(`통합_RAW_데이터_0310_1023.xlsx`)을 기준으로 파싱
   212→- 표의 긴 텍스트 셀(초빙분야, 배정사유 등)은 `max-w` + `truncate` + hover 툴팁으로 처리

## Spec Review: `2026-03-13-to-haejung-dashboard-design.md`

The spec is well-structured and covers the core requirements clearly. Below are the issues found, categorized by severity.

---

### Critical Issues (must fix before implementation)

**1. Section 7: `xlsx` is already a production dependency**

The spec says "xlsx 패키지가 없으면 `npm install xlsx` 필요" — this is factually wrong. `xlsx` is already listed in `package.json` dependencies at `^0.18.5`. This note will mislead the implementer into second-guessing the dependency state. Remove it and replace with the actual concern: the `xlsx` library at v0.18.5 does **not** run in the Next.js Edge runtime, so `route.ts` files using it must explicitly set `export const runtime = 'nodejs'`. This pattern is already missing from the existing `/api/submissions/route.ts` but works by default. The new upload route must document this explicitly.

**2. Section 4 API: The PATCH route has no body schema defined**

`PATCH /api/to-haejung/[id]` is listed but the spec provides no shape for the request body. There is no answer to: does it accept a partial record (any subset of fields), or the full row? The implementer will invent this, and the client-side "inline edit" logic (Section 2-2) depends on knowing the exact shape. The spec must specify:

```
Body: { [fieldName: string]: string }   // partial — one or more field/value pairs
```

It should also state the response shape on success (e.g., `{ ok: true }` or the updated row).

**3. Section 3-2: Excel column mapping contains unresolvable ambiguity for `department`**

The spec states: `department` maps to `구분` with fallback to `학과명`. This is insufficient. There is no definition of when the fallback applies, what value `구분` normally holds (is it always the department name, or a category code?), and whether `학과명` is a separate physical column or an alias. An implementer with no access to the original Excel file cannot implement this deterministically. The spec must clarify the exact column header text as it appears in row 1 (or row 2 if there is a merged header row) of the RAW Excel file, and define the fallback condition explicitly (e.g., "if the `구분` cell is empty or null, use the value from `학과명`").

**4. Section 4 API: GET response has no defined sort order or schema**

`GET /api/to-haejung` returns "전체 행 조회 (배열)" but specifies no ordering. The dashboard groups rows by `college` with alternating row colors — this grouping only works if rows are returned ordered by `college` then by some stable secondary key (e.g., `id`). The spec must add: `ORDER BY college, id` (or equivalent). Without this, the front-end cannot rely on the data being grouped correctly without performing a client-side sort, which is also unspecified.

---

### Important Issues (should fix)

**5. Section 2-2: No authentication or access control for the admin tab**

The existing `/admin` page has no documented auth mechanism, and the new "TO 배정 관리" tab adds write operations (upload that replaces the entire table, and inline edits). The spec adds a destructive `POST /api/to-haejung/upload` endpoint with no mention of any access restriction. At a minimum the spec should acknowledge this gap and either defer it explicitly ("auth out of scope — to be handled separately") or specify a basic check (e.g., same middleware as the existing admin page, or a simple secret header).

**6. Section 2-2: Inline edit — no specification for concurrent edit conflicts**

If two admin users have the page open simultaneously and both edit the same cell, the second PATCH will silently overwrite the first. The spec should either acknowledge this is acceptable (single-user admin assumption) or specify optimistic locking (e.g., include `updated_at` in the PATCH body and reject if it doesn't match the DB value).

**7. Section 3-1: `updated_at` is never updated by any described mechanism**

The schema defines `updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))` but there is no trigger and no mention in the PATCH handler spec of updating this column. In SQLite, `DEFAULT` only applies at `INSERT` time. The spec must note that the PATCH handler must explicitly set `updated_at = datetime('now')` in the UPDATE statement.

**8. Section 2-1: The main page (`/`) redirect removal breaks existing navigation**

The existing `app/layout.tsx` global nav has a link `href="/"` labeled "교원 상시채용 원스톱 관리 시스템" which currently redirects to `/dean`. Once `/` becomes the TO dashboard, users navigating the site will land on a different page than before. The spec does not address whether the `/dean` link in the global nav needs updating, and does not mention that `app/layout.tsx` needs a nav link to the new TO dashboard (the spec only adds a button inside the page body). The spec should explicitly state what changes are needed in `app/layout.tsx`.

**9. Section 5: `schema.sql` update strategy is unspecified**

`lib/db.ts` runs `db.exec(schema)` on every cold start using `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`. Adding the `to_haejung` table to `schema.sql` will work only for fresh databases. For existing databases (where `sangsi.db` already exists), the new table will be created correctly on next startup because of `IF NOT EXISTS`. This is fine, but the spec should confirm this migration strategy is intentional — no ALTER TABLE, no separate migration step.

**10. Section 2-2: File size and type validation for Excel upload is unspecified**

The spec shows a file picker restricted to `.xlsx` but does not specify: (a) maximum file size limit, (b) server-side MIME type validation (client-side `.xlsx` restriction is bypassable), (c) behavior if the uploaded file is a valid `.xlsx` but does not match the expected RAW data column structure (i.e., missing expected columns). The spec should define what happens when column headers do not match the mapping table in Section 3-2 — does the upload fail with an error, or are missing columns silently treated as null?

---

### Suggestions (nice to have)

**11. Section 2-1: `truncate` tooltip behavior is underspecified**

The spec mentions `max-w + truncate + hover 툴팁` for long text cells but does not specify which columns get this treatment, what the `max-w` value is, or whether the tooltip uses a native `title` attribute or a custom Tailwind/CSS tooltip. Standardizing this upfront avoids visual inconsistency across the 5+ free-text columns (`invitation_field`, `request_reason`, `assign_reason`, `hq_opinion`, `note`, `remark`).

**12. Section 3-1: No `UNIQUE` constraint on `(college, department)`**

The table allows duplicate rows for the same college+department combination. Since the upload strategy is full table replacement (DELETE + INSERT), duplicates in the source Excel would produce duplicate rows. A `UNIQUE(college, department)` constraint — or at minimum a note that the upload logic should deduplicate — would prevent data integrity issues.

**13. Section 2-2: Toast message implementation is unspecified**

"성공/실패 토스트 메시지" appears in the upload section. The project has no existing toast library (none in `package.json`). The spec should clarify whether to implement a simple in-component state-based message (consistent with the existing codebase pattern of inline error divs in `AdminDashboard.tsx`) or introduce a library dependency.

---

### Summary

The spec is NOT APPROVED in its current form. There are 4 critical issues and 6 important issues that would cause implementation ambiguity or bugs. The most urgent fixes are:

1. Define the PATCH request/response body schema (Section 4)
2. Clarify the `department` Excel column fallback logic (Section 3-2)
3. Add `ORDER BY` to the GET endpoint spec (Section 4)
4. Remove the incorrect `xlsx` install note and add the `runtime = 'nodejs'` requirement (Section 7)
5. Specify `updated_at` update behavior in the PATCH handler (Section 3-1)
